card.name: Ending of interleukin and similar words
card.fires_on: The final piece "in" of the word interleukin, right before a hyphen and number (interleukin-1, -2, -15). It also fires on a few other partway-through points in long words like prazosin, pollens, eggnog and melanoma.

modes.label: Interleukin ending
modes.description: The "in" that completes interleukin just before a hyphenated number or abbreviation.
modes.example: concurrent use of anakinra (an interleuk<<in>>-1 antagonist) and another TNF

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Partway or near the end of other long words split into pieces, such as drug names and food or allergen words.
